blockers.title: Letter of Acceptance not yet received
blockers.user_message: You cannot apply without an LOA from a DLI. An admission/offer email is not enough — you need the official LOA. Beware agents enrolling you at non-DLI 'colleges'.
blockers.recommended_next_step: A valid Letter of Acceptance from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI) is mandatory. Your study permit application cannot proceed without one.
blockers.rule_source_name: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)

blockers.title: DLI not verified on the official government list
blockers.user_message: Check the DLI number on the government list yourself. Many Pakistani students are mis-sold into institutions that are not DLIs or have lost PGWP eligibility.
blockers.recommended_next_step: You must personally verify your institution appears on the official DLI list at canada.ca. Agents sometimes direct students to unlisted or PGWP-ineligible institutions.
blockers.rule_source_name: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)

blockers.title: DLI number not yet obtained
blockers.user_message: The DLI number (starts with 'O') is required in the application. It is on your LOA.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your DLI number (starting with 'O') must be entered in your study permit application. It is printed on your Letter of Acceptance.
blockers.rule_source_name: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)

blockers.title: LOA not confirmed for correct upload section
blockers.user_message: An LOA in the wrong field can cause the system not to register it. Follow the document checklist exactly.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your LOA must be uploaded in the correct document section. An LOA placed in the wrong field may not be registered by IRCC.
blockers.rule_source_name: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) Required — Must Be Uploaded Correctly

blockers.title: School may not validate LOA with IRCC
blockers.user_message: Since the LOA-verification system, IRCC checks LOAs directly with institutions. A fake or unverifiable LOA = refusal and a misrepresentation finding.
blockers.recommended_next_step: IRCC verifies LOAs directly with institutions. A fake or unverifiable LOA results in refusal and a 5-year misrepresentation bar under A40.
blockers.rule_source_name: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) Required — Must Be Uploaded Correctly

blockers.title: Letter of Explanation not yet prepared
blockers.user_message: Canada has no 'GS form' like Australia — your study plan/Letter of Explanation IS your case for being a genuine student who will leave on expiry. Weak SOPs and weak home ties are the top Pakistani refusal reasons.
blockers.recommended_next_step: A Letter of Explanation (study plan/statement of purpose) is essential. Canada has no GS form — your LOE is your primary evidence of genuine study intent.
blockers.rule_source_name: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry

blockers.title: PAL/TAL not yet received (non-Quebec, non-exempt)
blockers.user_message: Most non-Quebec post-secondary applicants must include a PAL/TAL or the application is returned. It is issued by the province after you have an LOA.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Most non-Quebec post-secondary applicants must submit a PAL/TAL with their application or it will be returned. It is issued by the province after you receive your LOA.
blockers.rule_source_name: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) or Territorial Attestation Letter (TAL) Required

blockers.title: PAL/TAL not confirmed for submission with application
blockers.user_message: The PAL/TAL must be in the initial submission. Sending it later does not fix a returned application.
blockers.recommended_next_step: The PAL/TAL must be included in your initial application submission. Sending it after the fact does not fix a returned application.
blockers.rule_source_name: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) or Territorial Attestation Letter (TAL) Required

blockers.title: CAQ not yet received (Quebec applicant)
blockers.user_message: Quebec study requires a CAQ from the province before/with the federal study permit. No CAQ = cannot proceed for Quebec.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Quebec study requires a Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ) from the province before the federal study permit can be issued. Without it the application cannot proceed.
blockers.rule_source_name: Quebec Applicants Need Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ)

blockers.title: CAQ may not include required attestation/allocation
blockers.user_message: The CAQ must reflect Quebec's attestation/allocation. An incomplete CAQ will not satisfy IRCC.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your CAQ must include Quebec's required attestation and allocation confirmation. An incomplete CAQ will not satisfy IRCC.
blockers.rule_source_name: Quebec Applicants Need Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ)

blockers.title: Living funds fall short of the required threshold
blockers.user_message: Outside Quebec, a single applicant must show CAD 22,895 for living costs (from Sept 2025), separate from tuition and travel. More for dependants; Quebec is higher.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Outside Quebec, a single applicant must show CAD 22,895 for living costs (from September 2025), separate from tuition and return transport. Insufficient funds is a top refusal cause.
blockers.rule_source_name: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025

blockers.title: Total funds fall short of the required threshold
blockers.user_message: Total must cover CAD 22,895 living + first-year tuition + ~CAD 1,500 return transport (plus dependants). Funds must be genuine and accessible, not a paper figure.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your total evidence must cover living costs plus first-year tuition plus return transport (~CAD 1,500). Funds must be genuine, accessible, and consistently held.
blockers.rule_source_name: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025

blockers.title: Immigration medical exam not yet completed
blockers.user_message: An IME is required for 6+ month stays. Pakistani applicants typically need TB screening (chest X-ray).
blockers.recommended_next_step: An immigration medical exam by an IRCC panel physician is required for stays of 6 months or more. Pakistani applicants typically require TB screening.
blockers.rule_source_name: Medical Exam Required for Stays of 6+ Months

blockers.title: Medical exam may not be from an IRCC panel physician
blockers.user_message: Only exams by IRCC panel physicians count. A cheaper local clinic's report is worthless for the permit.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Only exams conducted by IRCC-approved panel physicians are accepted. A report from a local clinic not on the panel list is worthless for the study permit application.
blockers.rule_source_name: Medical Exam Required for Stays of 6+ Months

blockers.title: Document authenticity not confirmed — misrepresentation risk
blockers.user_message: Misrepresentation (fake bank balances, altered transcripts, hidden refusals) causes refusal AND a 5-year ban under A40. This applies even if an agent did it in your name.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Any misrepresentation — fake bank balances, altered transcripts, hidden refusals — triggers refusal and a 5-year inadmissibility bar under A40, even if an agent prepared the documents.
blockers.rule_source_name: All Documents and Statements Must Be Truthful (Misrepresentation Bar)
